home_headline: Translate Tekst to IPA Right Now
home_intro: An open-source phonetic transcription tool weh support character-by-character an phrase-based translation fi linguists, learners, an researchers.
home_feat1_desc: Zero data leave yuh device. All translation dem get calculate direct inna yuh browser fi maximum privacy an instant speed.
home_feat2_desc: Extensive support fi a wide range a languages, use highly accurate romanization an IPA conversion tables.
home_feat3_desc: Built fi di community. Inspect di code, contribute to di translation tables, or run it entirely offline.
home_agent_desc: Not a human user? Use agent.html— query via URL parameters, get plain text IPA back. No UI overhead, no installation, fewer tokens. Works wid agent-browser, Playwright, Puppeteer, an any JS-capable browser tool.
home_footer_desc: Dis open-source project translate tekst fram various languages to International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) notation. It use IPA databases an romanization conversion tables fi provide accurate phonetic transcriptions.
